edits.fidelity_note: Enhanced derivative, not a recovered high-resolution original. Generative restoration may interpret indistinct fine details. Used as a CDIS venue illustration; no claim that this is the particular room in which the 2003 session was recorded.
edits.tone_adjustment: Final image-generation edit requested a subtle approximately -0.15 to -0.2 stop exposure reduction from the first restored image, with the original composition and warm colors retained. This supersedes the intermediate brighter variant.
